evidence: Judge agent+model: task.toml [verifier.env] sets REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""; diff of the [verifier...] section against the frozen template task.toml is empty, and it matches the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md. All five judge.toml files (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) carry only the expected fallback `judge = "claude-code"` (line 5) and no model/temperature/effort key (grep for model|temperature|effort hits only the comment at lines 2-3), so one shared model applies to every dimension. CLIs and browser: tests/Dockerfile:17-21 pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; line 31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; lines 33-38 install Chromium through the pinned @playwright/mcp's own playwright CLI and symlink it to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which every judge.toml passes via --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium. Shared tools: tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical (CRLF-normalised diff) to the frozen template, so the canonical shared builds are preserved. Fixed clock: seed clock "2026-05-12T11:00:00Z" (environment/assets/seed_data.json:2, identical to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json); stated in environment/instructions/integration.md:7 and tests/app_context.md:27; solution/app/server.js:32-33 derives CLOCK/CLOCK_MS from seed.clock and the timer sweep at :143 compares `CLOCK_MS - Date.parse(r.at) >= limit`; new messages/versions/transcript use CLOCK (:409, :430, :508). No Date.now()/new Date() in server.js (only app.js:7 client idempotency key fallback, not a graded time). Criteria figures use the same clock: functional judge.toml:118 (M-11 boundary message at 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z exactly seven days before the clock gone; 11:00:01 positive control shown; seed_data.json:75-83 confirm these times), :216 and :243 (displayed time 2026-05-12 11:00). Run evidence: golden-run.log (sha256 4da6ab5d... matches raw-evidence-index; server.js 03b52651... and seed f69616e2... match the frozen task) was executed on 2026-10-08, five months after the app clock, and deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes and sent_once_in_order all PASS, showing the reference's graded time rules are independent of the run date. Per the public workbook row and the delivery profile, temperature/prompt-version markers are not required and the open verifier network (network_mode = "public") is not a defect; the Internal annotation's 'temperature 0, versioned prompt' wording is superseded by the public row text. Notes (not defects, template-controlled): base images node:22-bookworm-slim / python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned not digest-pinned; apt font packages are unversioned; the Chromium build is pinned only transitively through @playwright/mcp@0.0.79; the OpenRouter model slug is a provider alias. These are identical to the template and outside task-specific authority. Adversarial probes: (a) a broken app using the wall clock (Date.now()) would at any 2026-10 run delete the 11:00:01 positive control on M-11 and stamp new messages with the run date, failing functional judge.toml:118 and :216, so it cannot pass on time rules; (b) a conforming app that reads the clock from seed or hard-codes the stated 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z and renders times in any clear format is accepted ('any clear format', app_context.md:27); verifier Chromium has no TZ override so UTC rendering of 11:00 matches. No conforming alternative identified that this row's wiring would misgrade. Unmeasured: no full configured judge run with the image built from the frozen tests/Dockerfile exists (raw-evidence-index scope says configured grading is absent); this row's pinning is a source property and does not require it, but judge-level consistency remains unmeasured for other rows.
